chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham al-Khurasani, from al-Mufazzal ibn Umar, who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) in Kufa during the days when Abu al-Abbas arrived. When we reached al-Kunasa, he (peace be upon him) said: 'Here was where my uncle Zayd was crucified, may Allah have mercy on him.' Then he continued until he reached the stall of the oilmen, which is the end of the lamp-makers, and he dismounted and said: 'Dismount, for this place was the first Masjid of Kufa, which Adam (peace be upon him) marked, and I dislike entering it while riding.'

I said: 'So who changed it from its original marking?' He said: 'As for the first one, it was the Flood in the time of Noah (peace be upon him). Then the companions of Kisra and Nu'man changed it, and after that Ziyad ibn Abi Sufyan changed it.'

I said: 'And was Kufa and its mosque in the time of Noah (peace be upon him)?' He said to me: 'Yes, O Mufazzal. And the dwelling of Noah and his people was in a town, at a place from the Euphrates that faces the west of Kufa.'

He said: 'And Noah (peace be upon him) was a carpenter, so Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, made him a Prophet and chose him. And Noah (peace be upon him) was the first to make a ship that sails on the surface of the water.'

He said: 'And Noah (peace be upon him) remained among his people for a thousand years except fifty years, calling them to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. They would mock him and laugh at him. So when he saw that from them, he supplicated against them, saying: 'My Lord! Do not leave upon the earth any dwelling of the disbelievers. Indeed, if You leave them, they will lead astray Your servants and will not give birth except to a wicked, ungrateful one.'
So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Noah: 'Make a ship, and make it spacious, and hasten its work.'
So Noah built a ship in the Masjid of Kufa with his own hands. He brought the wood from afar until he finished it.

Al-Mufazzal said: 'Then the hadith of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) was interrupted at the time of the sun's decline. So Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) stood up and prayed Dhuhr and Asr, then left the mosque. He turned to his left and pointed with his hand to the place of the house of al-Darriyyin, which is the place of the house of Ibn Hakim, and that is the Euphrates today.'
He said to me: 'O Mufazzal! And here were set up the idols of the people of Noah (peace be upon him): Yaghuth, Ya'quth, and Nasr.'

Then he continued until he mounted his animal. I said: 'May I be your ransom, in how long did Noah build his ship until he finished it?' He said: 'In two periods.' I said: 'And how long are the two periods?' He said: 'Eighty years.' I said: 'And indeed the general public say that he built it in five hundred years.' He said: 'No! How is it, and by Allah, it has been revealed to us?'
I said: 'Inform me about the statement of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic:
Until when Our command came and the oven overflowed
He said: 'The oven was in the house of an elderly believing woman, behind the Qiblah of the right side of the mosque.' I said to him: 'For that is the place of the corner of Bab al-Feel today.'
Then I said to him: 'And was the beginning of the water's emergence from that oven?' He said: 'Yes. Indeed, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, loved to show the people of Noah a sign.'

Then indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, sent rain upon them flooding with a flood, and the Euphrates overflowed with a flood, and all the springs overflowed with a flood. So Allah, Exalted is His mention, drowned them and saved Noah and those with him in the ship.

I said to him: 'How long did Noah remain in the ship until the water subsided and they came out of it?' He said: 'They remained in it for seven days and their nights. And it circled around the House for a week, then it settled on al-Judiyy, and that is the Euphrates of Kufa.'

I said to him: 'Indeed, the Masjid of Kufa is old.' He said: 'Yes, and it is the prayer place of the Prophets (peace be upon them). And indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed in it when he was taken on an ascension to the sky.'

So Jibra'il (peace be upon him) said to him: 'O Muhammad! This is the mosque of your father Adam (peace be upon him) and the prayer place of the Prophets (peace be upon them). So descend and pray in it.' So he descended and prayed in it.
Then indeed Jibra'il (peace be upon him) ascended with him to the sky.

key_terms.الْجُودِيِّ: Al-Judiyy (the place where the ark settled)

ai.seo_question: Where was the first mosque in Kufa and what is the significance of the 'oven' in the story of Noah's flood?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies the first mosque in Kufa as the site marked by Adam (AS), linking it to the history of Noah (AS) who built his ark there over eighty years. The narration clarifies that the 'oven' (Tannur) mentioned in the Quran was the source of the flood's initial waters, located in the house of a believing woman, and notes that the Ark rested on Al-Judiyy, identified as the Euphrates near Kufa. This hadith highlights the spiritual significance of Kufa as a place of prayer for prophets, including Muhammad (SAW) during his Night Journey.
